title: Classic Japan Trails | Group Tour Package
highlights: From Tokyo's cityscape to Nikko's historic sites and Kyoto's serene shrines, experience the essence of Japan, covering its diverse landscapes and scenic views.
Marvel at the iconic Kaminarimon Gate of Sensoji Temple, known for its massive red lantern and historic significance as the gateway to Tokyo’s oldest temple.
Visit Kinkaku-ji, one of the most photogenic temples in Japan and admire the beauty of its top two floors completely covered in gold leaf, creating a stunning effect.
Admire the stunning Matsumoto Castle, featuring a six-story donjon (main tower) that offers scenic views of the surrounding landscape and Japanese Alps.
Explore Taiyuinbyo Mausoleum, known for its carvings from Edo period and as the final resting place of Tokugawa Iemitsu, the third leader of Tokugawa shogunate.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel
2 nights stay in Tokyo with breakfast
1 night stay in Kyoto with breakfast
Crow Castle Tickets, Matsumoto and ticket
1 night stay in Nagano with breakfast
Zenkoji Temple Tickets, Nagano and ticket
Snow Monkey Park Tickets, Yamanouchi and ticket
1 night stay in Shibukawa with breakfast
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
Tips and Gratuities: Driver, Guide, and Hotel Staff
know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of booking, and also upon arrival. PAN card will not be considered a valid address proof.
All international participants will have to share passport and visa details on arrival.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the hotel will be charged at actuals.
Any personal expenses or items of a personal nature will not be included in the package.
Do not consume alcoholic beverages or drugs, if you are found intoxicated, you might be asked to leave the tour/premises.
Learn basic Japanese phrases like "Konnichiwa" (hello) and "Arigatou" (thank you).
Bring a portable charger for your devices, as power outlets may be scarce. Carry an adapter for Type A or Type B sockets.
﻿﻿Remove your shoes when entering someone's house, traditional house or a temple in Japan.
Always remember not to leave chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice, as it's considered disrespectful.
It's not customary to leave a tip for your server in Japan, as tipping isn't a standard practice in restaurants here.
Using your phone for calls during a train or bus journey is considered inappropriate etiquette in Japan.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time at Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo! Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be driven to your hotel. After you check in, relax for a while. Later, in the evening, board the transfer from the hotel to Tokyo station to take the metro for Shinjuku (fare included). After reaching, explore the area at your leisure. You can enjoy the vibrant life of Golden Gai or refresh yourself by visiting Shinjuku Gyoen National Garden, famed for its colourful flora. Later, you'll be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Get ready to explore Tokyo’s famous places on a sightseeing tour. After you board the transfer from the hotel, you'll be first driven to Zojoji Temple, where you can take photos with Tokyo Tower in the background. Then, see Shibuya Crossing, famous for its crisscrossed streets. Continue to Omotesando to explore the Imperial Palace and see the Nijubashi Bridge. Then, get driven to Akihabara, followed by a visit to Sensoji Temple. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Kyoto Sightseeing Tour | Leisure Time at Gion District
days.desc: After you check-out from the hotel, get transferred to Tokyo Station to take the bullet train to Kyoto (fare included). Upon arrival, get driven to the hotel for check-in. After relaxing for a while, get transferred for the Kyoto sightseeing tour and visit the amazing Fushimi Inari Shrine and Imperial Palace, among other places. Later, get driven to the Gion district, famed for its Geisha culture and spend time at leisure. Later, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Nagano | Leisure Time in Tsumago | Crow Castle Visit
days.desc: Prepare to check-out from the hotel and board the transfer to Nagano. En-route, enjoy a stop at Tsumago, where you can spend some leisurely time exploring the stunning Tsumago Castle and take a walk along the scenic Nakasendo Trail, known for its beautiful views. Afterwards, you'll be driven to Matsumoto to see its impressive Crow Castle, known for its intricate architecture and historic courtyards. Continue your journey to Nagano. Upon arrival at the hotel, check-in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ikaho | En-route Zenkoji Temple & Monkey Park Visit | Leisure Time at Kusatsu
days.desc: After checking out from the hotel, you'll be transferred to Nagano. Upon reaching, visit Zenkoji Temple, known for its ancient Buddhist statues. While you are there, also take part in Gomakuyo ceremony, known to bring good fortune. Next, get driven to Monkey Park and see snow monkeys in their natural habitat. Continue the journey to Kusatsu, where you can explore at your own pace. Finally, proceed to Ikaho, and upon arriving, check-in at a traditional Ryokan-style hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Nikko Sightseeing Tour | Departure from Tokyo
days.desc: In the morning, check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Nikko. Upon reaching, enjoy a sightseeing tour of the city. Begin by visiting Toshogu Shrine, known for its Crying Dragon painting. Post that, explore the historical Iemitsu Mausoleum, followed by an amazing walk at Kanmangafuchi Abyss, a beautiful gorge created by Mt. Nantai's eruption. After that, you'll be driven to Tokyo. Upon reaching, head to the airport on your own for your flight back home.
